title: IRLBench: A Multi-modal, Culturally Grounded, Parallel Irish-English Benchmark for Open-Ended LLM Reasoning Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLM reasoning capabilities across 12 academic subjects from the 2024 Irish Leaving Certificate (e.g., Science, Business, History, Politics & Society). It does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core component of the study.
